description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the EmployeeLanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends EndpointTestCase and covers methods testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and internal service methods related to employee language data in the HR system.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeLanguageAPI, covering methods such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and validation rules, ensuring proper functionality and validation within the HRM system.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data from a YAML file to set up test database state.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee language record by ID, with success and failure cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules used when fetching a single employee language, including permission checks.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all language records for an employee, ensuring correct data and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving multiple employee language records.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies the creation of a new employee language record, including handling invalid input.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the create operation, including input constraints.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee language record and handles not found cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee language records, including permission errors.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for deleting records.
